map.位移公式（x = v₀·t + ½·a·t²）: Displacement formula (x = v0 t + 1/2 a t^2)
map.初速 6 m/s，末速 30 m/s，历时 4 s: Initial 6 m/s, final 30 m/s, over 4 s
map.平均加速度只看首尾两个速度，抹掉了中间过程。例如汽车先猛加速再缓行，平均加速度可: Average acceleration only sees the first and last velocities and wipes out the middle. A car that accelerates hard then coasts may average just 6.000 m/s2, while the instant at launch is far larger. Safety analysis should look at instantaneous values rather than the average.

map.用实验测得的速度端点值求一段过程中的平均加速度。: Uses the experimentally measured endpoint velocities to compute the average acceleration over a process.

map.输入末速度 v、初速度 v₀、时间 t，求平均加速度。: Enter final velocity v, initial velocity v0 and time t to get average acceleration.
map.速度变化除以时间得平均加速度。: Velocity change divided by time gives average acceleration.
map.：a = (10−20)/2 = −5 m/s²。即 2 秒内减速 10 m/s: : a = (10 - 20)/2 = -5 m/s2, that is decelerating by 10 m/s in 2 s with an average acceleration of -5 m/s2, where the minus sign indicates deceleration.
map.：a=(v−v₀)/t=(30−6)/4=6.000 m/s²。若末速小于初速，: : a = (v - v0)/t = (30 - 6)/4 = 6.000 m/s2. If the final velocity is below the initial one the result is negative, indicating deceleration.
